protocol: byte-identical to E228 e226_auc2W: task-wise z-score on fit rows -> sqrt(w_b) block weights -> subtract fit mean pm, multiply PCA W -> k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity).

scoring.score: score = -d1, d1 = distance to the nearest same-task prototype (E233 winner scoring)
scoring.alignment: E233 mean_align, copied verbatim: per (session, task) on Test remove the unlabeled batch mean in the frozen PCA space and add back the per-task train fit-row mean. Applied with one identical rule to both sessions.

delta_config.space: frozen deploy PCA96 (deploy_auc2_lofo transform); for the LOSO calibration the delta is re-expressed in each fold's own PCA96 space with the same fold's transform, so that the shift is compatible with the points it is applied to.
delta_config.variant_A: TRANSDUCTIVE: delta_A[t] = mean over all Test session2 rows of task t - mean over all Train rows of task t, in the frozen PCA space. Uses unlabeled Test inputs.
delta_config.variant_B: TRAIN-ONLY synthetic drift: apply the declared drift profile to the raw Train waveforms of a deterministic subset, re-extract all 10 feature blocks, transform, and take the mean displacement mean(z_drifted) - mean(z_clean) per task. No Test row is used.
delta_config.variant_A_half: 0.5 * delta_A, an interpolation candidate fixed before the run.

P1_gain_tilt_noise_reref.per_channel_gain_note: +3 / -3 dB by channel index parity, deterministic and fixed for the whole simulated session
P1_gain_tilt_noise_reref.note: all four nuisance families named in the task (per-channel gain, spectral tilt, noise, re-reference), applied on the raw waveform.

P3_tilt_neg_gain.per_channel_gain_note: one +-3 dB draw per channel, seed fixed, constant for the whole simulated session

delta_config.component_note: one-block decomposition of the synthetic drift: tells which nuisance family produces the delta_B magnitude. Diagnostics only; no candidate is derived from them.

drift_subset.rule: 20 evenly spaced trials inside the fit range (frac <= 0.6) of each subject x task cell, deterministic (same rule as E225/E226).

stability.note: delta_A is re-estimated from two random halves of the session2 rows of each task; report cosine and relative norm difference.

threshold.rule: tau = (1-A) quantile of the deploy model inner 5-block OOF KNOWN scores (fit rows, all 20 identities); A bisected so that the pooled (micro) LOSO rejection of the held-out impostors is the largest value still >= 0.90.
threshold.shifted_rule: identical, but the held-out impostors are first translated by delta (z + delta_task) before the min-distance score is recomputed; the OOF known scores used to read the tau quantile are NOT shifted (a registered user is mean-aligned in the scoring pipeline, which removes the batch offset).
threshold.order_stats_rule: consistency check: instead of the per-task geometric shift, subtract one scalar Delta_order from every impostor score, Delta_order = pooled mean of (score_orig - score_shiftA) over all folds and impostor rows; the same bisection then follows.

clean_reextraction_vs_cache.corr_logspd_note: the corr block is recomputed from raw instead of read from the frozen cache; a small difference is expected because the E65 cache is the reference implementation of the same formula

tau_orig.role: reproduction control: must reproduce E233 mean_align S1 1.0 / S2 0.312155 / sepAUC 0.879522

calibration.note: bisection to the largest A that still clears the target

tau_shift_A.role: transductive delta from Test session2 vs Train mean

limitations: Official Test C / RA / ASafeR are N/A: Test has no identity labels. S1 rejection >= 0.95 is a reviewer-imposed proxy, not an official metric. delta_A is transductive (it reads the unlabeled Test session2 mean), so any candidate derived from it sits in a grey zone of the competition rules. Session and registration status are confounded (E232: S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 registered users). Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65, so every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias; the candidates and the bisection rule are fixed in this file before the run.
